Market Surveillance Data and Technology Analyst: August 2027 Start
Experience Level New Graduates Job Categories Legal + Compliance
Overview

The Operations Analyst Program is a rotational development program that offers a broad and in-depth exposure to business operations at Susquehanna and will prepare you for a Compliance Analyst position that immediately impacts our business. 

During the first six months of the program, you will work alongside the operations team to gain in-depth exposure to the trading desks and various business areas at Susquehanna. Your rotations are designed to provide insight into how Susquehanna is structured and will incorporate hands-on experience through daily responsibilities and project work. Your project work is designed to familiarize you with the overall operations of the firm and flow of information as it pertains to compliance. In addition to rotations, the program includes classroom training sessions focused on developing company-specific knowledge, technical skills, and business effectiveness skills. You will continuously build relationships and a network of colleagues across the firm which will be an invaluable resource throughout your career at Susquehanna. 

Once you complete the program, you will begin your career in compliance with a focus on surveillance technology and analytics. Our compliance team helps ensure that the firm operates within regulatory requirements. You will support the buildout of our global surveillance platform, working with large market and trading datasets and applying machine learning, AI, and big data techniques to support surveillance analytics. You will collaborate with surveillance, trading, technology, and operations teams as the platform develops. You will also learn about U.S. broker-dealer regulation and securities such as equities, options, and fixed income products. 

Throughout the program, you will be mentored by senior members of Susquehanna's compliance and operations teams who will work with you to guide your development process. At the end of your rotations, you will be expected to leverage your diverse skill set and knowledge of Susquehanna's business to maximize your impact as a member of our compliance team.  

What we’re looking for
Pursuing bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or other related fields 
Ability to start full time in August 2027 
Strong programming and data analysis skills, with experience demonstrated through coursework, projects, or internships 
Experience with Python and SQL preferred  
Exposure to machine learning, AI, or large datasets preferred 
General knowledge of market structure and trading mechanics preferred 
Ability to leverage AI tools thoughtfully, independently validate outputs, and explain your reasoning 
Ability to collaborate with a team while having the confidence to work independently 
Ability and desire to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills 
Visa sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this position now or in the future 

 

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com. Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.
